concerns.text: SC‑003 requires attribution scores to be measured against independent physical measurements, but no task (T001‑T014) addresses external validation of attributions; current tasks only check internal substructure enrichment.
The plan lists a 'Contract Validation' step, yet no task explicitly performs schema validation of dataset or output artifacts beyond implicit checks in other tasks.
The plan mentions 'Entity Usage' to ensure pipeline stages consume/produce defined entities, but there is no dedicated task that verifies this traceability across the pipeline.
